business.title: Telecom market consolidation leads to more investment, industry group GSMA says
business.description: MLex Summary: Consolidating European telecom markets to three players from four leads to increased investment not higher prices, industry group GSMA said in a study. Since 2016, markets which have moved to three players have invested about 48 percent more per connection than four-player markets, leading to faster networks and better 5G coverage, it said. The group urged competition regulators to take a broader approach, focusing more on whether companies “can achieve efficient scale” and less on the number of operators in a country.
